parameters.description: Look up an order. Input: the order ID (format KC-####), or the word "sender" to look up by the sender's email when no ID was given. Returns order status, items, amounts, courier, tracking link and dates, or an error (not found / PRIVACY). Only data for the sender's own orders is returned.

Search the official Kesar & Co. FAQ (shipping, COD, cancellation, returns, damaged/wrong/missing items, refunds, products, medical safety, contact). Input: a short search query. Returns the matching FAQ sections verbatim, or says the FAQ does not cover it.

parameters.content:
## 1. Classify + extract (LLM)
Groq gpt-oss-20b, temperature 0, JSON mode. Output validated against `llm_output.schema.json` in code. Invalid -> one repair retry -> safe fallback (`other` + needs human). The email is passed as delimited untrusted data.

## 2. Policy engine (deterministic)
`Decide` runs code/policy.js: order lookup (ID, else sender email), identity check, date maths from `received_at`, return/damage windows, protocol table, needs_human rules. The LLM cannot override it.

## 3. AI agent drafts the reply
Tools: `get_order` (identity bound to sender in code) and `search_faq` (FAQ sections only). Draft is fact-checked: every amount, date and link must come from the order/FAQ; no cure claims; no leaks. Fails -> one redraft with verified facts -> safe holding reply + human.

## 4. Tickets (no duplicates) + audit log
Read Tickets -> open ticket for same order? update it (append email id + note) : create TKT-###. Every email gets one Audit Log row. v1 runs write to the "(v1)" tabs.
